messages:
Maya (AE): quick heads-up — Talus Health (healthcare analytics) wants a 2yr commit, Dedicated + Private deploy. asking for 45% off and a 4-week POC. security questionnaire bubbling up. can we approve or escalate?
Tom (Sales Ops): need the projected ARR and expected monthly tokens. 45% is steep, who owns approval here — deals desk or finance?
Maya (AE): projected first-year run-rate ~$1.1M ARR based on forecasted usage. POC expected low traffic first month. link to POC scope: https://redwood.internal/links/talus-poc (internal).
Priya (Finance): 45% on $1.1M is a big margin hit. baseline guidance: max 30% for 2yr with firm commit and prepay. can stretch to 35% with exec signoff + business case. need committed MRR and uplift model.
Lena (Security): Talus handles PHI-ish data; they want private deploy + KMS/HSM integration and audit logging. SOC2 + CIS controls required. Private adds operational cost. we need time for questionnaire review (2w).
Ethan (SE): POC scope: model-serving + secure data path. we can run POC in a sandbox VPC with token limits. recommend offering a limited POC credit instead of full discount during trial. can deliver implementation in 3 weeks if security signoff is quick.
Maya (AE): Proposal idea from my side: 35% off on list for full 2yr commit; include $50k credit for the POC and waived private-deploy onboarding fee. contingent on signed SOW and security checklist. thoughts? :thinking_face:
Tom (Sales Ops): can you drop the rough pricing calc here so revops can run numbers?
Maya (AE): sure — rough calc:
```
List price (est): $0.012/token => projected monthly bill $110,000
35% off => $71,500
Private deploy uplift: +$12,000
Net monthly => $83,500 (~$1.0M/yr)
POC credit: $50,000 one-time
```

Jordan (RevOps): running these numbers — with 35% + $50k credit we keep ~22% gross margin assumption if infra costs hold. need legal for contract language and an exec approval for concession >30%. tagging @deals-desk.
Priya (Finance): ok with 35% only if they do a 2yr commit with quarterly minimums and a 12mo prepay option. otherwise 30% with standard T&Cs.
Lena (Security): one more ask — KMS key must be customer-managed and we need SLA exceptions documented. if they require HSM on-prem, we should add an implementation fee.
Maya (AE): copying language for SOW + notes for Legal. can LegalBot kick off standard 2yr commit agreement with bespoke clauses?
LegalBot (bot): created ticket LEG-2457 with draft amendment for private deployment & KMS clause. ETA review 3 business days.
Tom (Sales Ops): action items: (1) Maya to confirm commit cadence (quarterly vs annual) (2) RevOps to finalize pricing model (Jordan) (3) Finance to approve concession floor (Priya) (4) Security to list must-have controls (Lena) (5) Legal to draft agreement (LegalBot).
Maya (AE): I asked Talus to confirm prepay/quarterly preference — they prefer annual prepay. will report back today. thanks all. :pray:
Jordan (RevOps): provisional decision from us: approve up to 35% discount + $50k POC credit for a 2yr committed deal with annual prepay and security checklist satisfied. escalate to CRO for anything >35%.
Priya (Finance): noted. finance final sign-off pending CRO confirmation.
Maya (AE): great — I'll push the SOW and confirm security timeline. will post update in this thread once Talus signs prepay intent.
Lena (Security): I'll start the questionnaire review now. ETA 10 business days for full sign-off unless they supply completed answers.
Maya (AE): update — Talus confirmed annual prepay intent via email. attaching (copied) to LEG-2457. next step: legal + finance finalize, then signatures. :white_check_mark:
Tom (Sales Ops): moving to deals-desk staging. tagging for transparency @deals-desk. :thumbsup:
